vintage: Frozen current-vintage data with reconstructed historical availability; pseudo-out-of-sample, not historical-vintage certification or prospective forecast.
scope: No new estimation, downloads, forecast repair, tuning or model promotion. Roster is declared, including failures.
horizons: h1..12, h0 retained in coverage and annual compounding; origins fixed by experiment forecasts
scores: RMSE=sqrt(mean((forecast-actual)^2)); MAE=mean(abs(forecast-actual)); bias=mean(forecast-actual). Score samples intersect finite rows for every named model independently per metric and horizon.
support: all_models_common includes the full declared roster. paired_MODEL includes exactly MODEL and STABLE_PIPELINE_R14B. Do not mix sample definitions. Missing forecasts remain in coverage_ledger.
samples: Full; origins2019-21; origins2022-23; origins2024+; recent targets from2024-01. No ex-post shock exclusions.
core: Original tests/fixtures/cleanup/cnb_core_mm.csv outcomes. Monthly percent core and cumulative sum of100log(1+core_mm/100) from h1 throughh. Missing intermediate month makes cumulative path missing; h0 core is not scored.
headline: headline_mm is separate from core_mm. Annual CPI is100expm1(sum12 monthly log rates), known history beforeorigin plus sameorigin monthly forecasts. Cumulated headline logs excludeh0.
direction: At h3/6/9/12 compare annual forecast/actual with origin t-1 known annual CPI. Up/down require change>0.25/<-0.25pp, otherwiseflat. material_turn_hit_rate requires correct material direction among materialactual moves; wrongway requires opposite materialcalls.
adjacent_headline_quarters: Calendar-quarter averages from oneorigin. Consecutive quarterchanges; materialactual meansabschange>0.25pp. Direction sign diagnostic and separate materialcalls both retained.
underlying_core: Four bands h1:3,4:6,7:9,10:12; annualizedSA logcore=12mean(100log1p(mm/100)-savedoriginseasonal[month]). Adjacentmaterialchange>=0.5ppannualized. Peak/trough atband2/3 requires two opposite materialchanges. Exactbandhits, missed actualturns and falsepredictedturns evaluated on matched support. No CNBcoreforecast claim.
revisions: Consecutive calendarorigins, identical targetmonth, newh=oldh-1; annualCPI revisions. MAE and maxabsolute revision, ownfinitepairs and matchedroster summaries. Revisiondoesnotrequire realisedoutcomes except matchedsummary currently uses finiteannualactualsupport.
corrections: Monthly logcore minus STATE_MID_R15 at identicalorigin,h; meanabsolute and quantiles. Selection/fits band indexes are original0..3; core diagnostic bands1..4. Coefficients multiply train-standardized predictors; penalizedconstant retained separately. Forest importance is impurity importance, not a causal effect.
cnb_cutoff_clock: latest existing as_of_utc strictlybefore nextday00:00Europe/Prague (through the entire CNBcutoffdate). Old independentaudit used startday and reported endday didnotchange selectedruns; this comparison explicitly uses endday.
cnb_support: Forecastquarters from2022 reports; eachthree-month quarterlyaverage uses known annualhistory formonth<origin and sameorigin forecast formonth>=origin. Scoreonlycomplete actual+CNB+allmodelquarters withinclock; separatecrossclock_common intersectsreport/quarter support overbothclocks. Repeatedoverlappingquartersaredependent and remainvisible.
cnb_gain: absoluteerrorgain=abs(CNB-actual)-abs(model-actual). Materialgain>=0.15pp; materialloss<=-0.15pp (1e-12 numerical tolerance). model-CNB deviation compared withactual-CNB error. Correctdirectionaloneisnotawin. CNBoutcomesneverenterfit/selection.
bootstrap: Pairedmean squaredlossdifference model-minus-pipeline. Moving12-consecutive-calendar-origin blocks,2000draws seed1509,2.5/97.5percentile interval; negativefavoursmodel. Keep exact finite pairedsupport, neverbridge calendarholes, reportoriginscoverablebyblocks. CIisdescriptive under dependentoverlappingforecasts; no multiplicityadjustment or promotionthreshold.
replay: Original CNBRounds template adapted in memory; all JS/CSS/data embedded and externalfontlinks removed. Checkboxeschangevisiblepaths only; fixedfullroster scorebasis remains. Separate reportclock/cutoffclock selector and reportselector. No networkneeded.
